summary: Match daemon agent rows by omitting subagents for scenario drivers that do not observe them

replay.detail: Scenario agent factories include subagents only for claude, codex and omp, matching the daemon; no deployed runtime replay change.

schema.detail: No database schema change; both agent row shapes use the existing optional client-v0 subagents field.

compatibility.detail: Scenario rows for non-observing drivers omit subagents instead of reporting an empty list. Existing fixtures use observing drivers and remain unchanged; no deployed protocol change.

manual.detail: No deployed installation action required; this change affects scenario factories and their consumers only.

recovery.detail: No database or runtime recovery change.
